source: 766 Early Labor
target: 766 Labor Primum

source: Gazing at the young man wearing red gloves, Franca cautiously asked, “Who might you be?”
target: Observans iuvenem indutum in chirothecis rubris, Franca cauta rogavit: “Quis es tu?”

source: She wasn’t about to trust a stranger just because of what he said unless influenced by some Beyonder power.
target: Non erat parata fidere ignoto solum ex verbis eius, nisi aliqua potentia Beyonder eam inspirasset.

source: “Two of Cups, Seven of Cups. You don’t need to be involved in what’s coming next,” said the young man in red gloves directly, calling Franca and Jenna by their Minor Arcana names.
target: “Duo Poculorum, Septem Poculorum. Non opus est tibi in re ventura implicari,” inquit iuvenis in chirothecis rubris directe, Francam et Jennam vocans nomina eorum ex Arcana Minoribus.

source: His voice carried the natural authority of someone used to leading many people, instilling a faint sense of fear in Franca and the others.
target: Vox eius naturalem auctoritatem, solitis multitudinem ducendi, intulit, modicum timoris in Franca et aliis infundens.

source: He knows our Tarot Club codenames…
target: Novit codenomina nostri Circuli Taroti…

source: A member of the Tarot Club?
target: Socius Circuli Taroti?

source: One of the Knight of Swords’ helpers?
target: Unus ex adiutoribus Eques Gladii?

source: His outfit looks like those “Red Gloves” from the Church of Evernight Goddess…
target: Indumentum eius illis “Chirothecis Rubris” ex Ecclesia Deae Semper Noctis simile videtur…

source: As Franca pondered, she didn’t sense any warning from her spiritual intuition.
target: Dum Franca meditabat, nullam admonitionem a spirituali intuitione sua sensit.

source: Before she could respond, the young man in red gloves pulled out a tarot card.
target: Antequam illa responderet, iuvenis in chirothecis rubris extraxit cartam Taroticam.

source: The card’s front depicted a goddess pouring holy water under a sky full of stars.
target: Frons chartae deam depingebat, quae aquam sacram sub caelo stellato effundebat.

source: Major Arcana, The Star!
target: Arcana Maiora, Stella!

source: So, it’s Mr. Star… Franca and Jenna hesitated no longer and nodded in unison, saying, “Okay.”
target: Ita, Dominus Stella est… Franca et Jenna non amplius dubitaverunt et unanimiter annuerunt, dicentes: “Bene.”

source: Lugano stood there, a bit dazed.
target: Lugano ibi stetit, paulo attonitus.

source: Why did he take out a card?
target: Cur cartam extraxit?

source: I think I’ve heard of something like this, but I can’t remember…
target: Puto me aliquid huiusmodi audivisse, sed non memini…

source: Almost simultaneously, Anthony appeared out of nowhere and squeezed in beside Franca and Jenna.
target: Prope simul, Antonius ex nihilo apparuit et iuxta Francam et Jennam accessit.

source: Franca was startled for a moment, muttering to herself, “I really did forget about you…”
target: Franca paulisper attonita fuit, sibi ipsi murmurans: “Te vere oblitus sum…”

source: Mr. Star didn’t say much more.
target: Dominus Stella non multum locutus est.

source: He opened his mouth slightly.
target: Leviserum os aperuit.

source: In an instant, Franca and the others were enveloped by a vast, invisible spirit, and then they ascended into the layered, colorful spirit world, like they were traveling in a hot air balloon.
target: In momento, Franca et ceteri ingenti spiritu invisibili involuti sunt, deinde in mundum spirituum stratis et coloratis ascendentes, quasi in globulo aerato calido peragrarentur.

source: Along the city’s periphery, covered in crystalline ice, Lumian, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, withdrew his gaze.
target: In lateribus urbis, glacie crystallina operitis, Lumian, indutus larva aurea familiae Eggers, oculos avertit.

source: He could roughly guess that the blurry figures in his eyes were the temperance faction’s demigods responsible for this operation.
target: Conjecturi poterat, figuras obscuras in oculis suis esse semideos factionis temperantiae, huic operationi incumbentes.

source: One of them, headless, seemed to resemble the temperance faction’s Angel he had seen before.
target: Unus eorum, caput carens, videbatur Angeli factionis temperantiae similis, quem antea viderat.

source: The translucent insects crawling in and out of his mouth were likely helpers invited by the temperance faction.
target: Insecta translucida, quae in ore eius intro et exire videbantur, probabiliter adiutores factionis temperantiae invitati erant.

source: How many people have taken residence in my body just now?
target: Quot homines modo in corpore meo insederunt?

source: Lumian grumbled internally as he followed the Knight of Swords, Maric, in a mad dash.
target: Lumian, interiora murmure, secutus est Eques Gladii, Maric, in impetu insanum.

source: They entered the wilderness outside Raklev under the pale, cold “sunlight,” heading swiftly toward Lake Dalsh.
target: In solitudinem extra Raklev ingressi sunt, sub pallida et frigida luce solari, celeriter versus Lacum Dalsh properantes.

source: Due to the unique influence of Paramita, Lumian couldn’t teleport anywhere beyond his line of sight.
target: Propter unicam vim Paramitae, Lumian ultra lineam visionis suae se transferre non potuit.

source: He had to use a visual lock to establish a position, which made it challenging to appear instantly at the edge of Lake Dalsh.
target: Oportuit ei uti vinculo visivo ad statum constituendum, quod apparere statim in margine Lacus Dalsh difficile faciebat.

source: After running some distance, he reached out and grabbed the Knight of Swords’ shoulder.
target: Post aliquod spatium cursu, manum protendit et humerum Eques Gladii arripuit.

source: Almost simultaneously, blazing white flames surged from within him, instantly covering his entire body.
target: Prope simul, flammae albae fulgentes ex ipso eruperunt, totum corpus eius statim tegentes.

source: The Knight of Swords understood his intent without asking and promptly dematerialized into a wraith, attaching himself to Lumian.
target: Eques Gladii consilium eius sine quaestionibus intellexit et statim in umbram evanuit, se Lumiano adnixus.

source: Lumian transformed into a white-hot spear and shot off into the distance in a brilliant display.
target: Lumian in hastam candentem se transformavit et, in splendidum spectaculum, in distantia volavit.

source: The flaming spear streaked through the sky, crossing vast distances to arrive at the edge of Lake Dalsh in no time.
target: Hasta ardens per caelum transvolavit, ingentes distantias superans atque in oram Lacus Dalsh celeriter perveniens.

source: As Lumian detached from the blazing white spear, he noticed that even in Paramita, intertwined with the spirit realm, this lake remained tranquil, clear, sacred, and beautiful.
target: Cum Lumian a hasta candenti albi se distulit, animadvertit quod etiam in Paramita, coniuncta cum regno spirituum, hic lacus tranquillus, clarus, sacer atque pulcher permaneat.

source: In the dim surroundings, the gray-white water seemed weightless, stretching upwards like a giant curtain, perhaps drawn to some high-altitude entity.
target: In obscuritate circumiectis, aqua cinereo-alba levitate carens videbatur, sursum extendens ut velum ingens, fortasse ad aliquam altitudinem attrectatam.

source: In front of the water curtain, countless human skulls formed a mountainous head.
target: Ante velum aquae, innumerabilia crania humana, ut caput montuosum, formabant.

source: Among the skulls of various colors, one stood out the most.
target: Inter crania diversorum colorum, unum maxime eminuit.

source: It was at the very top, crystal clear as if carved from crystal, and significantly larger than a normal human skull.
target: Illud in vertice erat, crystallinum quasi ex crystallo sculptum, et notabiliter maius quam cranium humanum solitum.

source: Instead of pale or dark red flames, the eye sockets of this crystal skull reflected a mysterious, intricately patterned, ancient bronze door.
target: Pro flammis pallidis aut rubris obscuris, fossae oculorum huius cranii crystallini repraebant ianuam aeneam antiquam, mysteriosa et subtiliter ornatam.

source: The door was slightly ajar, revealing endless darkness within.
target: Ianuam paulum aperta erat, infinitam obscuritatem intus patefaciens.

source: In that darkness were countless indescribable eyes, staring out yet unable to emerge.
target: In illa obscuritate innumerabiles oculi ineffabili erant, spectantes sed emergere non poterant.

source: Along the edges of the bronze door, strange, grotesque, and sometimes revolting hands grasped the frame as if trying to squeeze through but unable to. They only managed to scratch out piercing noises that seemed to tear at the human eardrum.
target: Ad margines ianuae aenea, manus insolitae, grotescae atque interdum repulsivas, limen prehendebant, quasi per transitus exprimere conantes sed non potentes; solum sonos acutos stridentes ediderunt, qui quasi tympana humana lacerabant.

source: Many spirits and human skulls were drawn to this place, gradually becoming part of the massive head.
target: Multae animae et crania humana ad hunc locum trahebantur, paulatim in partem ingentis capitis versa.

source: Is that crystal skull the Undying’s skull used back then?
target: Estne hoc cranium crystallinum, cranium Immortalis, illo tempore usitatum?

source: Is the bronze door in its eye sockets the Death Sequence 5’s Gatekeeper’s door to the Underworld?
target: Estne ianua aenea in orbitis eius porta Custodis Sequenciae Mortis V ad Orcos inferos?

source: Hmm, a Sequence 5 can’t keep the Underworld door open for long, so they used the Undying’s skull and the unique properties of Lake Dalsh to fix it…
target: Hmm, Sequencia V ianuam Orcorum non diu patefacere potest, itaque cranium Immortalis et proprietates unicas Lacus Dalsh ad id reparandum adhibuerunt…

source: But where has Oxyto, the Shaman King, gone?
target: Sed quo abiit Oxyto, Rex Scamanorum?

source: As this thought crossed Lumian’s mind, he saw the countless human skulls forming the massive head in the air open and close their bony teeth, speaking in unison in various voices: “Why couldn’t you give me a little more time?”
target: Dum haec cogitatio per mentem Lumiani transibat, vidit innumerabilia crania humana, ingens caput in aere formantia, dentes ossa aperientes et claudentes, una voce variis modis loquentia: “Cur non mihi paululum temporis tribuistis?”

source: “If I can’t have it, I’ll destroy this place and see how many of you can survive the calamity of this collapsing Paramita!”
target: “Si id mihi non obtineri potest, hunc locum delam et videbo quot ex vobis calamitatem huius Paramita corruentis superesse possint!”

source: “And I have already abandoned this place and left the Raklev region using my prior preparations!”
target: “Et iam hunc locum deserui atque regionem Raklev, praeparationibus meis usus sum!”

source: “Hahaha, hahaha!”
target: “Hahaha, hahaha!”

source: Amid the sharp, hoarse, old, and deep laughter of the human skulls, Lumian felt the massive shadow in the sky descend toward his head.
target: Inter acutum, raucem, vetustum et profundum risum craniorum humanorum, Lumian sensit ingentem umbram in caelo versus caput suum descendere.

source: Cracks appeared in the ground below, growing deeper and revealing a dark void.
target: Fissurae in terra inferiore apparuerunt, crescentes in profundum et tenebrosum abyssum revelantes.

source: All the skulls, including the crystal one, developed tiny cracks, seemingly ready to shatter completely in no time.
target: Omnia crania, etiam cranium crystallinum, parvas fissuras formaverunt, quasi mox omnino dirumpenda erent.

source: At that moment, Lumian felt a chill leave his body, and all the skulls stopped cracking as if temporarily held back by an invisible external force.
target: Illo momento, Lumian sensit frigidum ex corpore suo fugere, et omnia crania fissuras facere cessare, quasi a vis invisibili externa temporarie continerentur.

source: This also halted the process of Paramita’s collapse and destruction.
target: Hoc quoque processum ruinae et destructionis Paramitae sistit.

source: Although it didn’t reverse, it wasn’t going to happen immediately.
target: Quamquam non restitutum est, non statim evenire paratum erat.

source: Is this the temperance faction’s demigod or their invited helper using their ability? It seems Oxyto really escaped.
target: Num hic est semideus factionis temperantiae aut adiutor eorum invitatus, facultate utendo? Videtur Oxyto revera effugiisse.

source: After testing the waters with the Banshee’s Howl, she decisively abandoned this Paramita, clearly stronger than other Madames, and used her prior arrangements and the unique properties of this place to escape before the temperance faction could act…
target: Postquam aquas per ululatum Banshee temptavit, illa constanter hanc Paramitam deseruit, manifeste fortior quam alia dominae, et priores dispositiones atque proprietates unicas huius loci ad effugiendum, antequam factio temperantiae agere posset, adhibuit.

source: A series of thoughts flashed through Lumian’s mind as he took in the scene before him.
target: Seriae cogitationum per mentem Lumiani fulserunt, dum scaenam ante se intuebatur.

source: An ancient voice suddenly echoed in his ears: “Don’t just listen to what Oxyto says.
target: Vox antiqua subito in auribus eius resonavit: “Noli solum audire quod Oxyto dicat.”

source: In my experience, anyone who leaves behind so many words before running away is either already insane or trying to cover up something.
target: Experientia mea docet: quisquam qui tot verba relinquit antequam fugiatur, aut iam insanus est aut rem aliquid tegere conatur.

source: Oxyto did indeed flee here decisively before we locked onto her and planned to destroy this Paramita, but why would she tell us her objectives? Purely to vent her emotions?
target: Oxyto quidem hic effugit, antequam eam apprehenderemus et hanc Paramitam delere consiliaveremus, sed cur nobis sua proposita narrare vellet? Numquid solum ad affectus suos efferendos?

source: That may be one reason, but there should be a more important one: she wants us to focus on the collapse and destruction of this Paramita and overlook something else.
target: Id fortasse una causa sit, sed aliter gravius: illa vult ut nos ruinae et destructioni huius Paramitae incumbamus, aliam rem autem neglegamus.

source: Lumian hadn’t entirely dismissed his doubts after Oxyto’s proclamations through those human skulls, but such behavior wasn’t unusual for the indulgence faction of the Rose School of Thought.
target: Lumian dubitationes suas post pronuntiata Oxyto per illa crania humana non omnino deiecit, sed talis mos non erat insolitus pro factione indulgentiae Scholae Rosarum.

source: Those accustomed to indulgence were always eager to express their emotions.
target: Qui indulgentiae assuefacti erant, semper affectus suos exprimere studebant.

source: The ancient voice finally said, “Time will provide us the answer.”
target: Vox antiqua tandem inquit: “Tempus nobis responsum dabit.”

source: As soon as these words fell, Lumian saw the insects with translucent rings flying out.
target: Simul cum verba illa ceciderunt, Lumian vidit insecta annulis translucidis volitantia.

source: Suddenly, everything around him slowed down.
target: Subito, omnia circa eum tardaverunt.

source: A grayish-white fog settled over everything Lumian saw, making it all look surreal.
target: Caligo cinereo-alba super omnia, quae Lumian vidit, consedit, efficens ut omnia quasi insueta apparerent.

source: Soon after, everything projected on the foggy “curtain” started to rewind.
target: Statim postea, omnia in velo caliginoso proiecta retrogradari incipiebant.

source: The human skulls were no longer cracked in countless places, the ground returned to smoothness, and the thick shadows receded into the sky.
target: Crania humana non iam in innumeris locis fissata erant, terra laevis restituta, et umbrae denses in caelum recedebant.

source: Time wasn’t moving backward; rather, recent history and events were being displayed.
target: Tempus non retrorsum currebat; potius, recentia historia et eventus ostendebantur.

source: Lumian then saw a pair of brown wings that could blot out the sky, leaving the current shadow behind.
target: Tum Lumian par alarum fuscatarum vidit, quae caelum obruere poterant, umbram praesentem relinquentia.

source: Between the wings, each feather as large as a human head, stood a female figure with an exposed abdomen.
target: Inter alas, quarum singulae plumae tam magnae erant quam caput humanum, stabat figura feminea cum ventre patefacto.

source: The woman was as beautiful as the moon at night, her face radiating maternal brilliance, but her hands and feet were arched, with sharp nails that gleamed coldly.
target: Femina erat tam pulchra quam luna nocturna, vultu materno radiante, sed manus et pedes eius incurvati erant, cum unguibus acutis frigide micantibus.

source: This was the Shaman King, Oxyto.
target: Hic erat Rex Scamanorum, Oxyto.

source: Having seen her male form, Lumian recognized her instantly.
target: Cum formam eius masculinam viderit, Lumian eam statim agnovit.

source: Her features were softer now, and her facial details were more delicate.
target: Lineamenta eius nunc leniora erant, atque singula vultus teneriora.

source: Her belly was swollen, stretched taut with black veins visible on the surface.
target: Venter eius tumidus erat, expansus nervis nigris in superficie conspicuis.

source: The skin was so thin that it was almost transparent, revealing the merging forms of numerous bird‐clawed monster infants inside.
target: Cutis tam tenuis erat ut paene perspicua videbatur, ostendens formas miscendas multitudinis infantium monstrorum ungulatorum avium intus.

source: She… stuffed all those corpse‐born bird‐clawed infants into her belly…
target: Illa omnes illos infantes, ex cadaveribus oriundos cum ungulis avium, in ventrem suum impluit…

source: What kind of monster is she nurturing?
target: Quale monstrum illa alit?

source: No wonder the bloodline connection didn’t work directly, only indirectly within a certain range…
target: Non mirum nexus sanguinis non directe operatus est, sed solum indirecte intra certum spatium…

source: As Lumian came to this realization, Oxyto reached for her belly in the scene from the past.
target: Cum Lumian hoc intellexit, Oxyto manum ad ventrem suum protulit in scaena praeterita.

source: With a tearing sound, she ripped her abdomen open, blood pouring out.
target: Cum sono stridente, ventrem suum laceravit, et sanguis effudit.

source: Oxyto forcefully pulled out an infant slightly smaller than Ludwig.
target: Oxyto vi abrupte extraxit infantem paululum minorem quam Ludwig.

source: Its skin was pale, its flesh decayed, and remnants of four or five heads and seven or eight bird claws remained on its surface.
target: Cutis eius pallida erat, caro corrupta, et reliquiae quattuor vel quinque capitum atque septem vel octo ungulorum avium in superficie eius manebant.

source: A pure, clear membrane, seemingly from Lake Dalsh, covered the baby’s body.
target: Membrana pura et clara, quasi ex Lacu Dalsh orta, corpus infantis tegebat.

source: Oxyto let out a cry of agony as she threw the infant into the eye socket of the crystal skull.
target: Oxyto gemitum doloris edidit, dum infantem in orbitam oculorum huius cranii crystallini iecit.

source: The rotten, multi‐headed infant was clearly much larger than the eye socket and the bronze door within it, yet it mysteriously shrank smaller and smaller until it squeezed through a gap barely wide enough for a hand, disappearing into the boundless darkness behind the door.
target: Infans putridus et pluricapitatus manifeste multo maius erat quam orbis oculorum et ianua aenea intus, attamen mysteriose paulatim minuebatur, donec per angulum vix latum manu transire potuit, in immensam obscuritatem post ianuam evanescens.

source: Is Oxyto’s ultimate goal to send that monster infant into the Underworld, making some terrifying thing a reality?
target: Estne propositum ultimum Oxyto, illum infantem monstrum in Orcum inferos mittere, quoddam terribile factum efficere?

source: And now she’s been forced into early labor?
target: Et nunc illa in partum praecoce coacta est?

source: As Lumian had this thought, he realized the coldness inside him had vanished.
target: Cum Lumian hanc cogitationem habuit, animadvertit frigiditatem interioris se evanuisse.

source: The figure in the small black bonnet and the Knight of Swords in the vest and shirt simultaneously appeared in front of the crystal skull.
target: Figura in parvo nigro pileo et Eques Gladii in veste et camisia simul apparuerunt ante cranium crystallinum.

source: But they seemed unable to pass through the crack in the bronze door and were trying to open it a little more.
target: Sed videbantur non posse per fissuram ianuae aeneae transire, et eam paulo amplius aperire conabantur.

source: The Underworld… Wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, Lumian felt a stirring inside.
target: Infernum… Indutus larva aurea familiae Eggers, Lumian sensit motum intimum.

source: Seizing the opportunity provided by the temperance faction demigods stalling Paramita’s collapse, he activated the black mark on his right shoulder, teleporting to the front of the crystal skull.
target: Occasione capta a semideis factionis temperantiae, qui ruinae Paramitae moram ferebant, activavit notam nigrum in humero dextro suo et se in fronte cranii crystallini translocavit.

source: In his eyes, the bronze door loomed abnormally large.
target: In oculis eius, ianua aenea insolitē ingens videbatur.

source: He stretched out both hands and pressed them on either side of the bronze door.
target: Manus utramque protendit et in utrisque lateribus ianuae aeneae apposuit.

source: A hollow, muffled buzzing filled the air as the bronze door opened a little wider.
target: In aere sonitus vacuus et submurmurans replebat, dum ianua aenea paulum latius aperiebatur.

source: Lumian immediately felt a terrifying suction, and with a swish, he was pulled through the crack, flung deep into the darkness.
target: Lumian statim sensit terribilem vim attrahentem, et cum sibilo, per fissuram trahendus, alte in obscuritatem iactus est.

source: Inside him, two more cold masses joined him.
target: Intra eum duo alia corpora frigida ei se adiunxerunt.
